lawyer:
Moksudur Rahman, Senior Advocate instructed by Md. Afiab Hossain, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Appellants 
Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed instructed by Sharifuddin Chaklader, Advocate-on-Record ----- For respondents No. 1-4 
Ex-parte -----Respondent Nos. 5-18
parties:
Mozirullah and others ----- Appellants
Vs.
Shafukuddin Ahmed and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: The learned appellate Court as it appears from his judgment without considering the evidence either the documentary evidence or the oral evidence abruptly came to the conclusion that the plaintiff failed to prove his title. The learned Judge also failed to consider the evidence as to possession and dispossession. The suit being a suit for declaration of title and recovery of possession, the learned Judge ought to have considered the evidence relating to title as well as possession and further the act of dispossession so as to pass a finding as to pass a decree or dismissing the suit. Non consideration of vital evidence relating to possession and dispossession affected the decision of the learned Judge materially and this error has occasioned a failure of justice. The finding arrived at by the trial Court having not been adverted, the judgment complained of is not a proper judgment for reversal as such is liable to be set aside.
